name: Engineering contract LINE group file review and retained attachments

dataIsolation.guard: Resolve candidates only from tenant-local messages in the authorized contract group; disclose retained originals only from a LINE-authorized session's issued package.

definitionOfDone: Reviewers see archived LINE file candidates and can preview originals
Explicit retained selections create an immutable next version with classifications and LINE provenance
Excluded files never automatically reappear and original files are never deleted
Contractors and verified group members can read the exact issued version's retained original attachments
Private Drive state and attachment hashes are checked on public reads
Tenant, project, group, capability and stale-version tests pass
Production and Android LINE verification are recorded before marking Deployed
